title: Retained output recapture and completion
description: Exercise completion deduplication and capture recovery, run output-capture-recovery.mjs against a separate disposable fixture: a completed artifact-only run with COMPLETE artifacts duplicated in its captured manifest, both the flow-preferred narrative and report.md, and a .output-validation-fixture file beside worker artifacts containing the fixture run ID. Set FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_RUN_ID, FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_FIXTURE_ARTIFACTS, FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_EXPECT_REPORT_PATH and FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_REGRESSION_ROUTE. The driver temporarily removes read permission from and restores only the marked worker artifact directory and proves the resulting gateway and UI state. Include a retained video whose frame rate is available only on COMPLETE, and a second dispatching retry fixture sharing this task with output.workerFinished=true and completedAt cleared. Set FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_VIDEO_PATH, FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_VIDEO_FPS and FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_ACTIVE_RETRY_ID. Re-seed the active retry snapshot before repeating this negative control.

capture-recovery.intent: Prove preferred narrative selection and unique completed-run file counts, then make a real refresh fail and verify the stale review disappears, the error is visible and a successful recapture creates a new review without changing execution.
